data.one_liner: WidgetFactory extension to render HTML IMG tags using cached_network_image.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WidgetFactory extension for flutter_widget_from_html_core to render HTML image tags using the cached_network_image plugin. It allows cached network images to be seamlessly integrated into HTML strings rendered by HtmlWidget.
use_when: You are using flutter_widget_from_html_core to render HTML content.
You need cached network images inside your HTML strings.
avoid_when: You only need standard image widgets without HTML parsing.
strengths: Leverages the popular cached_network_image plugin for caching
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml and mix in CachedNetworkImageFactory to your WidgetFactory.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to render cached network images directly in Flutter widgets rather than parsing them from HTML strings.
